text:
alerts-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=kv-cache (inc=INC-4302) — p99 latency spike + mem pressure on prompt_prefix_v2 namespace. runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/kv-cache

oncall-sre: I'm on it, creating incident channel. seeing KV miss rate jump from 2% -> 48% on prefix cache. rolling logs now.

cheng: quick check — canary tokenizer change deployed ~2025-05-14T12:02Z. any chance tokenization altered prompt hashing? if yes we can get cardinality explosion. also saw batch config bumped max_batch_size -> 512 yesterday.

maria: confirmed via sampling: massive key churn, many new unique prompt keys per second, TTLs close to zero because of miss write patterns. memory on cache nodes creeping up, eviction thrashing.

oncall-sre: Impact visible: increased inference latency and 502s for some customers. CS: three paying customers reported errors on onboarding flows. severity escalating.

customer-success: We're getting pages from two customers in EU region. They report user-facing errors and timeouts, some aborted signups. Need ETA for mitigation.

opsbot: Runbook step 1 -> try quick mitigations: disable continuous batching OR reduce batch window. Suggest disabling continuous batching first.

oncall-sre: Executing disable now.

oncall-sre: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-runtime CONTINUOUS_BATCHING_ENABLED=false -n prod`

oncall-sre: Done — propagation ~30s.

maria: purging hot shard to free memory (shard 7):
```
redis-cli -h kv-7.cluster --eval "EVAL \"return redis.call('del', unpack(redis.call('keys', ARGV[1])))\" 0 'prompt_prefix_v2:*'"
```

maria: purge issued. monitoring mem stats.

cheng: starting rollback of tokenizer patch on canary (reverting commit 7a1d9). if hash function changed we need to restore old hashing immediately.

jonathan: also lowering batch_timeout to 10ms to avoid long queuing (quick API call):
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/ops/v1/config -d '{"batch_timeout_ms":10}'`

oncall-sre: Both mitigations applied (continuous batching disabled + batch_timeout=10ms). p95 latency improved from ~450ms -> ~120ms over the last 2 minutes, error rate trending down.

alerts-bot: Incident severity lowered to SEV-2 (customer impact reduced). Paging paused.

customer-success: Notifying affected customers with temporary mitigation notes. They asked for ETA for permanent fix.

cheng: I will take the permanent fix: plan = 1) revert tokenizer change in non-prod and validate prompt hash cardinality; 2) if revert not viable, implement backward-compatible hashing shim that maps new tokens to old prefix space; 3) add automated pre-rollout test to measure unique-prefix-per-minute delta.

maria: follow-ups I started: (a) force-regen prompt keys for affected tenants via migration job; (b) add alert: unique prefix keys/min > threshold; (c) add rollout gating on tokenization divergence metrics.

jonathan: patching batch config: revert max_batch_size to 128 and add auto-throttle when cache_miss_rate > 0.4. will open PR and deploy to canary later today.

oncall-sre: system stabilized. handing off to @cheng for the long-term remediation and postmortem. Handoff notes: mitigations applied, customers notified, migration job queued, owners assigned. follow ticket INC-4302 for updates.

cheng: Ack, taking over. I'll coordinate rollback and schedule a postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 PT. tagging security for a quick review of any KMS/HSM interactions during key regen.

customer-success: Thanks for the quick response — we'll send a customer update once the rollback is confirmed. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Incident summary saved to https://redwood.atlassian/incidents/INC-4302. Action items: CHENG (owner), JONATHAN (batch config), MARIA (alerts + migration), ONCALL-SRE (postmortem facilitation).

oncall-sre: closing channel for now — will re-open if regression observed.
